name: Uiverse Design
summary: Collection of framework-agnostic CSS design systems that AI coding agents apply to build consistent product interfaces.
description: A library of portable CSS design systems for AI-assisted products: each system ships source files, a logo, fonts and colors, plus a setup prompt you copy so a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others) applies the design. The systems are themed by domain — earth-systems research, civic data portals, ceramics studios and more — with fifteen listed, some marked Premium and their previews behind sign-in.
